non_blocking_notes: Secret detection regex covers major API key formats (Bearer, sk-*, AIza*, ya29, api_key, access_token, client_secret patterns); if patterns expand, document rationale for scope. Task queue sorted deterministically (priority then task_id), maintaining consistent operator view. Worker identity binding correctly cross-checks model_id and budget.worker_id against active task—proper three-way identity match enforces consistency.
result.reasoning_summary: Mission Control projection creates an immutable read-only bounded view of harness state with strict enforcement of tenant isolation, dependency bounds, secret detection, and identity matching. Implementation uses frozen dataclasses to guarantee immutability of returned views. Validation is deterministic and comprehensive: tenant format validated; all tasks confirmed to belong to single tenant; all dependencies verified to exist in canonical queue; worker/model/budget identities cross-checked against current task; kill-switch enforced to ENGAGED state; secret patterns detected in visible task text. Patch is narrow (2 new files, no modifications). Test suite with 10+ functions covers happy path, denial cases, secret detection, identity matching, and idle state. Code owns no mutable state, grants no task/git/credential/policy/approval authority. Deterministic checks pass. Risk is low given pure validation nature, comprehensive test coverage, and immutable type contract.
